SELECT t.company_code AS id, '0' AS parent_id, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(o.office_name, '')), t.company_code) AS title FROM (
) t LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON t.company_code = o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL AND o.status = '0' GROUP BY t.company_code ORDER BY title
SELECT id, #{officeId} AS parent_id, position_name AS title FROM fms_position_archive WHERE type = 'CJ' AND region = #{officeId} AND status = '0' ORDER BY position_name
SELECT id, work_shop_id AS parent_id, prod_line_name AS title FROM fms_prod_line WHERE work_shop_id = #{workshopId} ORDER BY prod_line_name
SELECT id, prod_line_id AS parent_id, work_group_name AS title FROM fms_work_group WHERE prod_line_id = #{prodLineId} ORDER BY work_group_name

SELECT DISTINCT sp.id, #{workGroupId} AS parent_id, sp.name AS title, sp.identity_card AS id_card, sp.id AS person_id FROM swm_person sp LEFT JOIN fms_worker fw ON sp.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = fw.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
(fw.work_group_id = #{workGroupId} OR sp.team = #{workGroupId}) AND sp.identity_card IS NOT NULL AND sp.identity_card != '' AND (sp.status IS NULL OR sp.status = '' OR sp.status = '0') AND (sp.personnel_status IS NULL OR sp.personnel_status = '' OR sp.personnel_status = '1')
AND sp.person_type IN
#{personType}
ORDER BY sp.name

SELECT t.company_code AS value, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(o.office_name, '')), t.company_code) AS label FROM (
) t LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON t.company_code = o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL AND o.status = '0' GROUP BY t.company_code ORDER BY label
SELECT MIN(id) AS value, position_name AS label FROM fms_position_archive WHERE type = 'CJ' AND status = '0' GROUP BY position_name ORDER BY label
SELECT MIN(id) AS value, prod_line_name AS label FROM fms_prod_line GROUP BY prod_line_name ORDER BY label
SELECT MIN(id) AS value, work_group_name AS label FROM fms_work_group GROUP BY work_group_name ORDER BY label
